entities.summary: Amit Rohidas is an Indian field hockey player who plays as a defender. He also served as the vice-captain of the Indian national team. He was an important part of the Indian squad that won bronze medals at the 2020 and 2024 Olympics and gold medal at the 2022 Asian Games.
